  "object": {"columns": ["did"], "resolver": "curie", "category": "biolink:Disease", "name_column": "name"},
  "predicate": "biolink:associated_with",
  "association_category": "biolink:GeneToDiseaseAssociation",
  "knowledge_level": "prediction",
  "agent_type": "computational_model",
  "primary_knowledge_source": "infores:monarchinitiative",
  "qualifiers": {},
  "edge_properties": ["score", "ortholog_id"],
  "keep_if": null,
  "split_by": null,
  "by_value": null,
  "notes": "Monarch links a human gene to a disease because a model-organism ortholog has phenotypes similar to the disease. The score is a phenotype-similarity score. This is a computed inference, not a causal or genetic finding, so the predicate is the generic associated_with and the knowledge level is prediction. The human gene is the subject. No resolver exists for ortholog ids, so ortholog_id is carried as an edge property. No score cutoff is applied because the card documents no threshold."
}
